source_block.parva: Vana Parva · Yakṣa-praśna (lake ordeal / Dharma tests Yudhiṣṭhira)
source_block.divergence: BORI CE places the lake ordeal and Yakṣa-praśna in Vana ~3.297–3.298 (Debroy). Ganguli’s vulgate English maps the same arc under Vana Parva Yaksha / Aranyaka sections (commonly cited near CCCXI–CCCXII). Gita Press Gorakhpur tells the same Yakṣapraśna under its Vana adhyāya numbering. The beats agree: thirst in the forest; brothers sent for water; a voice forbids drinking without answers; they drink and fall; Yudhiṣṭhira answers; asked whom to revive first he names Nakula (fairness to Mādrī); the yaksha is Dharma, his father.
source_block.chosen: Gita Press Gorakhpur + BORI overlap: the Yakṣa-praśna itself as told in both. Debroy for BORI Vana ~3.297–3.298. Ganguli for English beat map of the questions and Nakula boon.
source_block.notes: Not TV. Comic-mythology yaksha (luminous spirit, not gore). Never attach Ep01 plate-wide-gold or this episode’s plate-wide-gold as Imagine refs. Nakula-first revival is load-bearing dharma — keep it in the rise beat.
